HediffDef.label: adhesion savant physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s spirit web has been permanently reshaped by Adhesion. The Connection surge has deepened {PAWN_possessive} empathy to an overwhelming degree - {PAWN_pronoun} binds words and relationships with instinctive mastery, but cannot emotionally detach from the suffering of those around {PAWN_objectPronoun}.

HediffDef.label: gravitation savant physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s sense of "down" has become permanently unstable. {PAWN_pronoun} moves with fluid confidence born of treating gravity as a suggestion, but the disconnect leaves {PAWN_objectPronoun} prone to stumbling and poor balance in close combat.

HediffDef.label: division savant physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s spirit web bears the permanent mark of Division. The destructive surge has bled into {PAWN_possessive} psyche - {PAWN_pronoun} strikes with devastating precision, understanding how things come apart at a fundamental level, but {PAWN_possessive} emotional range has been heavily dampened. Joy and sorrow alike feel distant and muted.

HediffDef.label: abrasion savant physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body has begun to resist friction at a spiritual level. {PAWN_pronoun} is extraordinarily difficult to strike or hold, but the same slipperiness makes gripping objects unreliable and {PAWN_possessive} body slides and shifts during sleep, preventing deep rest.

HediffDef.label: progression savant physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body has become hyper-responsive to biological processes. {PAWN_possessive} wounds knit with unnatural speed and {PAWN_possessive} immune system operates at a heightened baseline, but the uncontrolled growth surge drives a ravenous hunger as {PAWN_possessive} body constantly tries to grow and regenerate.

HediffDef.label: illumination savant physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s senses have been permanently sharpened by years of bending light, but the boundary between illusion and reality has blurred. {PAWN_pronoun} perceives more of the spectrum than ordinary humans, yet lingering afterimages and light distortions cause significant disorientation.

HediffDef.label: transformation savant physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body has begun taking on physical characteristics of the substances {PAWN_pronoun} most frequently Soulcasts. {PAWN_possessive} skin carries a faint texture - stone-like, wood-grain, or metallic sheen - granting natural resilience but an unsettling appearance that others find deeply disturbing.

HediffDef.label: transportation savant physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s perception has been permanently split between the Physical and Cognitive Realms. {PAWN_pronoun} navigates with remarkable speed, but occasionally "sees" into Shadesmar - overlapping realities fracture {PAWN_possessive} focus and make the mundane world feel unreliable.

HediffDef.label: cohesion savant physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has developed an intuitive sense for material structure at a molecular level. {PAWN_pronoun} builds and mines with preternatural efficiency, but {PAWN_possessive} body has begun to feel rigid and stone-like - movement is labored and sleep uncomfortable.

HediffDef.label: tension savant physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body has taken on a perpetual rigidity from Tension. {PAWN_possessive} skin and muscle carry a residual hardness that grants natural armor and remarkable pain tolerance, but {PAWN_possessive} joints have stiffened permanently - fine manipulation is difficult and movement is sluggish.
